description: Market-multiple engine. Apply peer multiples (P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, EV/Sales, PEG and more) or derive implied multiples to price a company on a comparable basis. Use this for market-approach pricing where peers exist; it does peer multiples only — for intrinsic cash-flow value use calculate_dcf, and for residual-income or IFRS-basis measurement use calculate_residual. Methods: ev_revenue: revenue, ev_revenue_multiple; ev_ebitda: ebitda, ev_ebitda_multiple; ev_arr: arr, ev_arr_multiple; ev_gmv: gmv, ev_gmv_multiple; pe: eps, pe_multiple; pb: book_value_per_share, pb_multiple; ps: sales_per_share, ps_multiple; cap_rate: net_operating_income, cap_rate; regression: intercept, growth_rate, growth_coefficient, market_maturity, maturity_coefficient; royalty_cap: revenue, royalty_rate, discount_rate; ddm: dividend_per_share, cost_equity, growth_rate. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

arr.description: Annual recurring revenue in reporting currency.

cost_equity.description: Cost of equity as a decimal (0.12 = 12%).

discount_rate.description: Discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%); pre-tax when method=viu_pre_tax.

dividend_per_share.description: Dividend per share in reporting currency.

gmv.description: Gross merchandise value in reporting currency.

growth_rate.description: Periodic growth rate as a decimal (0.03 = 3%).

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

net_operating_income.description: Stabilised net operating income in reporting currency.

royalty_rate.description: Royalty rate as a decimal (0.05 = 5% of revenue).

name: calculate_market_multiple

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Market multiples and comparable pricing
